note: INFORMATION-LIMITED ASSESSMENT — read the fit value with care. This is a late-stage contract negotiation with no discovery content whatsoever: no age, body composition, training history, health status, injuries or goals are mentioned in 23 minutes. Two criteria can be evidenced. Successful: he is a practising lawyer who reads and redlines contracts, runs back-to-back client meetings, travels internationally and describes himself as in 'a really busy time of my life'. Income: no price resistance at all — he negotiated term and exit rights, never the amount, and volunteered 'I'm willing to pay, like, tomorrow, the next day, whatever'. The remaining three criteria — neglected_health, good_to_great and not_deconditioned — could not be assessed at all, and `misses` is empty because nothing observed contradicts fit, not because he was found to satisfy them. 'Edge' is used rather than 'core' to avoid asserting a full match on two of five criteria; it should not be read as a judged shortfall. The discovery call that would settle this is not in batch_006 and the assessment should be superseded once it is located.
